# Enxi Hong

> Personal website of Enxi Hong.

## About

Enxi Hong's personal website at enxihong.github.io. Built entirely with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Hosted on GitHub Pages. Created with Claude Code from a phone while traveling.

## Games

The site features a collection of browser-based games playable on desktop and mobile:

- **Snake**: Classic snake game. Eat food to grow, avoid hitting yourself. Swipe controls on mobile.
- **Tetris**: Block stacking game with ghost piece, scoring, and increasing speed per level.
- **Fishy**: Eat smaller fish to grow, avoid bigger fish. Mouse or touch to move.
- **Breakout**: Paddle and ball game. Break bricks, catch power-ups, avoid bombs.
  - Power-ups: wide paddle, fast ball, slow ball, multi-ball, extra life, star (+50 pts)
  - Bombs: instant game over if caught

## Spiegel

A static viewer for the iOS App Privacy Report at /spiegel/. Drop the
`.ndjson` export in and it shows which app used which sensor and which domains
it contacted in the background. Runs entirely in the browser: no backend, no
runtime network calls, Content-Security-Policy limited to 'self'. German UI.
